I figured out source of a problem. There is should be try/catch for ReflectionTypeLoadException. It is not always possible to load every type and it is not always necessary, but still possible to get (almost) all the types from ReflectionTypeLoadException.Types.
See:
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.reflection.assembly.gettypes?view=net-5.0
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.reflection.reflectiontypeloadexception.types?view=net-5.0#System_Reflection_ReflectionTypeLoadException_Types
